choice.basis: The dashboard shows Station X (blue) on May 06 as the smallest visible segment across the chart, appearing as a thin sliver just above the 1,500 baseline, whereas May 09 shows a visibly taller blue segment. The May 06 Station X value is clearly the lowest among the dates shown. Since no explicit routing thresholds are printed on the chart, the visual evidence of the lowest relative demand for Station X on that date supports selecting the low-demand response option.
